_generated: generated by running both baseline routers as sealed programs on this board under a generous routing budget (up to 500 passes and a 300 s wall-clock budget per run; reference A given 8 worker threads, reference B allowed up to 30 stagnant passes) and measuring the resulting Layout under the spec's connectivity and DRC rules; the best (lowest incomplete-after with no added violation) of the runs is reported per reference

budget.runsPerReference: reference A up to 2 (its parallel search varies between runs; the lowest incomplete-after is reported); reference B 1 (its search is deterministic)

notes: Under the generous budget reference A joins all but 1 connection; reference A honours the 60 s job timeout the board file itself carries, so its wall clock stops there. Reference B leaves more within 300 s. The `routing-slow-dac2020-bm01-p2` case measures a two-pass floor (at most 28 incomplete after two passes), a different question from full-budget completion; this file records what completion the board actually admits. traceLengthMm is each reference's own reported routed-copper length in millimetres; the two references report on different length scales on some boards (a units-resolution difference), so the two are not directly comparable, and the figure is advisory.
